scope.flow: Epoch reward calculation in TrustBonding using end-of-epoch veTRUST balance snapshot
evidence: Rewards for each epoch are calculated using the user's veTRUST balance at the **end of the epoch**. Because the system relies on a single timestamp snapshot, users who bond immediately before epoch close can receive the same reward share as users who participated throughout the entire epoch.
Reward calculation uses the user balance at epoch end:
Because balances are evaluated only at the epoch end timestamp, the system ignores **how long the user held veTRUST during the epoch**.

statements.text: Bonding immediately before epoch close should not grant the same or disproportionate reward share as participating throughout the entire epoch.
evidence: Rewards for each epoch are calculated using the user's veTRUST balance at the **end of the epoch**. Because the system relies on a single timestamp snapshot, users who bond immediately before epoch close can receive the same reward share as users who participated throughout the entire epoch.
This allows attackers to capture a disproportionate share of emissions while only participating for a negligible portion of the epoch.
